sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Rerank 8B - 32K context, multimodal, open weights
sources.snippet: About Nemotron 3.5 Rerank 8B is an open-weight NVIDIA multimodal, multilingual reranker with 8.38 billion parameters and a 32,768-token context. It scores how relevant a document (text, page image, or both, including charts and tables) is to a text query, to reorder candidates from an embedding retriever in vision RAG pipelines.
